introHtml: LED light bottle openers combine two practical tools into one compact giveaway. The built-in light makes them useful at tailgates, camping trips, or outdoor events where visibility is low. Unlike standard openers, these stand out in a dark cooler or pocket. Decorate the flat metal body with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a durable, high-contrast finish that lasts.
